'''Weklae Baso''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. By [[3637 BBY]] he was working as a [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] in the [[Blaster's Path]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Weklae Baso appears as a cantina vendor in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' {{1st}}
